source_grounded_finding: Retrospective 2018 rainfall and gauge flows used to tune rules; not tested as a forecast at genuinely available issue times
Neeleswaram used for calibration and presented for accuracy; no separately established independent holdout
Just 17 annual maxima used for 200/500-year flood return periods
Large RP200 Gumbel vs LP3 extreme difference (~6000 vs 22000 m³/s)
Similarity of 2018 unsteady stage to 200-year Gumbel stage does not independently establish a 200-year event
Table 3 FCZ max sometimes below SZ min; these belong to different zones, inspect rule logic
Complete storage trajectories, operating-priority constraints and original reservoir model unavailable
No turbine-head, energy generation MWh or dispatchable MW model
3-hourly 2018 vs daily historical forcings confound apparent differences
Bias correction redistributes daily data to 3-hourly rainfall; weights and vintage not archived here
14 TRMM/GPM + 16 IMDAA grid counts versus 23 Grid IDs in Table 5 require crosswalk
Figure 6d water-yield scale to 250,000 mm requires unit/aggregation verification
Figure 5 caption repeats Mullaperiyar where text identifies Idukki in later plot group
Unexplained negative elevation reference in hydraulic profile
Figure 6d mis-cited where Figure 9d is intended
Flood-map “validation” lacks spatial overlap scores and aligned mask documentation
Figure 12 exact panel dates differ from some dates in narrative
Log Pearson lowest table fit errors in all rows, yet both Gumbel and LP3 carried forward with limited selection justification
Square-root consistency of MSE/RMSE does not establish robust fit/out-of-sample skill
Seven selected events cannot establish hydrology over all climate regimes
56 subbasins and 12.5m DEM use need vertical accuracy/hydro-conditioning checks
Only eight surveyed cross-sections for extensive 1D flood geometry
Unmeasured downstream normal-depth slope 0.001; test lower boundary effects
Muskingum routing x=0.5 corresponds to no attenuation in source explanation
Description repeats x=0 for both storage and pure transmission; suspect x=0.5 typo
Modelled ~9800 vs ~9000 observed peak is ~8.9% higher
Colored inundation maps cannot substitute for quantitative flood-depth and geospatial validation
Method-of-moments tail fits not sensitivity-tested versus L-moments/ML
Comparison of unsteady 2018 and steady RP200 water stage conflates distinct design assumptions
Full supplementary ST/SF input files and runnable HEC configuration are required for reproduction
